propositions: git commit --amend -F/-m replaces the entire commit message and drops the Change-Id trailer, causing Gerrit to stamp a new Change-Id and create a duplicate change instead of a new patchset
prepare-commit-msg hook cannot distinguish an -F amend from a fresh -F commit because git does not pass source information that identifies an amend when -F is used
A thin wrapper make amend-msg FILE=<path> must preserve the existing Change-Id from HEAD while rewriting the commit message, following the pattern used by Go, OpenStack, Android, and Chromium
The wrapper must fail loudly when HEAD has no Change-Id rather than silently proceeding, indicating the commit-msg hook is not installed
AGENTS.md documentation must name make amend-msg as the prescribed path for rewriting a commit message and explicitly warn that --amend -m/-F drop Change-Id and create duplicate changes
